column1: # The honest test: a long exchange that drops speech tags entirely.
# Tier 1 cannot resolve most of this and should say so rather than guess.

column2: They walked the length of the platform twice before either of them spoke.
You will miss it, said Ellen.
Then I shall wait for the one at nine tomorrow.
I am being deliberately calm. It looks similar from the outside.
A porter went past with a trolley, and they stood apart to let him through.
We have had it badly. I should like to have it well, once, before I go.
That is not a thing you get to decide.
The guard's whistle went somewhere down the platform.
Afterwards she could not remember which of them had said it.
